description: Defines the MailboxVideoFrameConverter class used for converting GPU memory-backed VideoFrames to mailbox-backed VideoFrames in ChromeOS. Includes class declarations, callback types, and method signatures related to GPU video frame conversion and shared image management.

classes.name: MailboxVideoFrameConverter
classes.description: Handles conversion of GPU memory-backed VideoFrames to mailbox-backed VideoFrames, manages shared images, and interfaces with GPU delegate.

classes.name: MailboxVideoFrameConverter::GpuDelegate
classes.description: Abstract interface for GPU operations related to shared image creation, updating, and synchronization.

classes.name: MailboxVideoFrameConverter::ScopedSharedImage
classes.description: Self-cleaning wrapper for shared images used during frame conversion.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of MailboxVideoFrameConverter with specified callbacks and options.

methods.name: ConvertFrame
methods.description: Enqueues a VideoFrame for conversion to mailbox-backed format.

methods.name: HasPendingFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are frames pending conversion.
